suggestions: I'm grateful for a PR that got approved with just a single "nice, LGTM" after I spent all week dreading the review.
I'm thankful for the makcik at the warung who remembers my order without me having to say a word.
I'm grateful for the sound of rain starting right as I close my laptop for the day, like it waited for me.
I'm thankful for a bug that turned out to be a missing semicolon, after an hour of suspecting my entire architecture.
I'm grateful for my mother's voice note reminding me to drink water, sent for absolutely no reason except she thought of me.
I'm thankful for the few minutes between Maghrib and dinner when the whole house just goes quiet.
I'm grateful for a teh tarik that's actually pulled properly, not just sweet milk tea pretending.
I'm thankful for the rezeki of a job offer coming through the same week the old contract ended.
I'm grateful for a colleague who DM'd me the Jira ticket instead of pinging the whole channel about my mistake.
I'm thankful for the breeze through the window during Isyak when the power's been out all evening.
I'm grateful for finding an old voice recording of my grandmother's laugh while clearing out my phone storage.
I'm thankful for a staging environment catching the thing that would've definitely broken prod.
I'm grateful for free parking at the mosque on a Friday when every other lot nearby is full.
I'm thankful for a group of friends who still show up for futsal even though half of us are clearly out of shape now.
I'm grateful for my phone battery lasting the whole day after I finally stopped doomscrolling at 2am.
